title: KIT/Offenburg a-IGZO Schottky diode paper (cites prior IGZO Schottky results)
supports: Secondary citations: O2 during noble-metal deposition gives Pt-IGZO barrier 0.92 eV, ideality 1.36; Ti-Pt/IGZO/Cu diode annealed 200 C reaches rectification up to 1e8, n=1.22; AgOx/IGZO 1e9 at +/-2 V, n=1.7 (via search snippet; secondary, originals not checked)

title: Sputtered Pt/a-IGZO Schottky diodes (IEEE Access, Jan 2020)
supports: Raising O2 fraction 1.64% -> 6.25% plus post-deposition anneal raises rectification 1e5 -> 1e7 at +/-1 V and barrier 0.64 -> 0.75 eV (via search snippet)

title: A high speed PE-ALD ZnO Schottky diode rectifier with low interface-state density
supports: PtOx/PE-ALD ZnO diode: ideality 1.31, effective barrier 0.79 eV, rectification 1.17e7, cut-off 550 MHz, interface-state density 5.13e12 cm-2 eV-1; high n attributed to interface states and contact inhomogeneity (via search snippet)

title: A high speed PE-ALD ZnO Schottky diode rectifier (Durham record, Jidong Jin et al.)

title: Thermally Stable Amorphous Oxide-based Schottky Diodes through Oxygen Vacancy Control at Metal/Oxide Interfaces
